name: Kadeworks EU Invoices with Peppol for WooCommerce
author: peppolkit

sections.description:
PeppolKit turns every paid WooCommerce order into a correct invoice, and sends it over Peppol when your customer is a Belgian business. Free for up to 20 invoices a month, no credit card. For Belgian shops, every invoice to a business customer goes over Peppol automatically, included in every plan. Consumers get their invoice by e-mail.

Since 1 January 2026 Belgian businesses must send and receive B2B invoices as structured e-invoices over the Peppol network. A PDF is no longer enough for a Belgian business customer. PeppolKit does this for you: you install the plugin, connect your shop and fill in your company details once. From then on every paid order gets its invoice automatically. Your shop can be established in the Netherlands, Belgium, France, Germany or Luxembourg.

More about PeppolKit for WooCommerce, with a short video: peppolkit.com/en/woocommerce

What you get

  • PDF plus Peppol BIS Billing 3.0 UBL, validated against EN 16931 and the Peppol rules
  • Optional VAT number field at checkout (classic and block checkout), checked live with the EU VIES service, reverse charge where required. Already using a VAT number plugin? PeppolKit takes the number from it
  • Credit notes automatically when you refund an order
  • Invoices to business customers sent over the Peppol network when they have a Peppol ID (mandatory for Belgian B2B since 2026)
  • Invoices in Dutch, French, English or German, in six designs, with your logo and brand colour; gapless numbering
  • VAT done right for EU sales: reverse charge for EU businesses, OSS or the €10,000 threshold for EU consumers, export rules outside the EU
  • Invoice download in the order screen, on the thank-you page, in the order e-mails and in the customer’s account
  • Your choice who e-mails the invoice: PeppolKit, or WooCommerce’s own order e-mails with the invoice PDF attached (credit note with the refund e-mail)
  • Overview screen: setup checklist, usage this month, the latest invoices with Peppol and e-mail status
  • Resend the invoice e-mail or (re)send over Peppol straight from the order
  • One click to the PeppolKit dashboard: all invoices, monthly export for your accountant, sample invoice, logo and brand colour
  • Orders that wait for an invoice (free-plan limit, missing company details) are kept and created later with one click
  • Create invoices for paid orders of the last 60 days

What you need

PeppolKit is a service: the plugin sends paid orders to PeppolKit, which creates, checks, stores and delivers the invoices. Connecting your shop creates a free PeppolKit account from within WordPress, no separate sign-up.

  • Plans: Free (20 invoices a month), Starter €9 (100), Growth €19 (500) and Pro €49 (unlimited), each with VAT rules, credit notes, PDF and UBL file. Paid plans are billed by PeppolKit, not through WordPress.
  • Peppol for Belgian shops: every invoice to a business customer goes over Peppol automatically, included in every plan. Consumers get their invoice by e-mail. No cost per send and no separate Peppol subscription. We send through our recognised Peppol partner SUPER PDP; when you connect, you confirm your company’s identity once (about 5 minutes: company number, a consent tick and a photo of your passport or ID card).
  • Peppol for shops in the Netherlands, Germany and Luxembourg: from the Starter plan, PeppolKit sends invoices to business customers over Peppol. You activate it once in the PeppolKit dashboard. On the free plan, Dutch shops send over Peppol through their own free Peppyrus account; German and Luxembourg shops e-mail the invoice (ZUGFeRD PDF in Germany, PDF and UBL in Luxembourg).
  • German shops: business customers in Germany also get the invoice by e-mail as a ZUGFeRD PDF (EN 16931 profile), included in every plan. You fill in your USt-IdNr. or your Steuernummer, and there is a switch for Kleinunternehmer (§ 19 UStG).
  • Luxembourg shops: you fill in your RCS number (for example B123456) or your matricule, invoices are in French by default, and there is a switch for the small-business franchise (art. 57bis LTVA).

PeppolKit can also receive your suppliers’ Peppol invoices: Belgian shops in every plan, shops in the Netherlands, Germany and Luxembourg from the Starter plan (optional, €0.20 per received document).

Works with

Tested together with these plugins (WordPress 7.1, WooCommerce 11.2, classic and block checkout):

  • EU VAT Assistant for WooCommerce (Aelia) 2.2.0: PeppolKit takes the VAT number from its field and hides its own field in the classic checkout. EU VAT Assistant has no field in the block checkout, so PeppolKit’s field stays there.
  • EU/UK VAT Validation Manager for WooCommerce (WPFactory) 4.8.2: PeppolKit takes the VAT number from its field in both checkouts and hides its own.
  • EU/UK VAT Compliance for WooCommerce (Simba, free) 1.36.14 and Germanized for WooCommerce 4.1.8: the free versions ask no VAT number, so PeppolKit’s field and reverse charge do that.
  • Custom Order Status Manager for WooCommerce (Bright Plugins) 2.1: tick your own “paid” status in the PeppolKit settings; its customer e-mail for that status carries the invoice PDF when you chose WooCommerce’s e-mails.
  • PDF Invoices & Packing Slips for WooCommerce (WP Overnight) 6.0.0: PeppolKit warns you and shows how to turn off its invoice, so your customer does not get two.
  • Polylang 3.9.2.

About the name

Kadeworks EU Invoices is made by Kadeworks, a Dutch software company (KvK 42214201). It connects your shop to PeppolKit, the invoicing service of Kadeworks, which also serves Shopify and PrestaShop shops. Peppol is the name of the open European e-invoicing network and standard, governed by OpenPeppol AISBL. The plugin sends invoices over that network through certified access points; it is not affiliated with, endorsed by or certified by OpenPeppol.

External service

This plugin sends order data (customer name, address, e-mail, VAT number, order lines and amounts) to the PeppolKit service at https://app.peppolkit.com to create, store and deliver invoices. Privacy policy: https://peppolkit.com/privacy · Terms: https://peppolkit.com/voorwaarden
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin (WooCommerce 8.0 or newer is required).
  2. Go to PeppolKit > Overview, check your e-mail address and click “Connect to PeppolKit”.
  3. Fill in your company details under PeppolKit > Settings: name, address, VAT number and Chamber of Commerce or enterprise number. Choose your options and save.
  4. To send invoices to business customers over Peppol, open the PeppolKit dashboard (Settings > Peppol). Belgian shops click “Connect SUPER PDP” and confirm their company’s identity once. Dutch shops connect their own free Peppyrus account (customer.peppyrus.be) and paste its API key there.

From then on every paid order gets an invoice automatically. A test order is a real invoice: it gets a number from the running series and counts towards your monthly invoices.

The installation guide with screenshots walks through every step.
sections.faq:
Do I have to create a separate PeppolKit account?

No. You connect your shop from WordPress, under PeppolKit in your menu, and that creates a free PeppolKit account automatically. You choose a paid plan in the PeppolKit dashboard, not through WordPress.

When is the invoice created?

As soon as an order reaches a status that means paid: processing or completed, unless you chose other statuses under PeppolKit > Settings > Other WooCommerce plugins. The invoice is created in the background, so checkout is never slowed down; it is usually ready within a minute. Each order gets one invoice, also when it passes through several of these statuses.

Can the invoice come with WooCommerce’s own order e-mail?

Yes. Choose it in the PeppolKit dashboard (Settings); the plugin’s settings page shows the current choice. WooCommerce’s order confirmation (processing or completed) and the invoice e-mail you send from the order then carry the invoice as a PDF attachment, and the refund e-mail carries the credit note. PeppolKit does not e-mail your customer itself. If the invoice cannot be made or fetched within a few seconds, the e-mail still goes out on time, without the attachment but with the download link. Invoices to business customers on Peppol still go over Peppol.

Is it really free?

The free plan covers 20 invoices a month, with VAT rules, credit notes, PDF and UBL file, and needs no credit card. For Belgian shops, Peppol is included for every invoice to a business customer, on the free plan too. Paid plans start at €9 a month; see the current plans.

Do I need Peppol?

Belgian businesses must send and receive B2B invoices over Peppol since 1 January 2026. If you sell to Belgian business customers from a shop in the Netherlands or Belgium, you need a Peppol connection. Belgian shops connect Peppol once in the PeppolKit dashboard; it is included in every plan. Shops in the Netherlands, Germany and Luxembourg send over Peppol through PeppolKit from the Starter plan, activated once in the PeppolKit dashboard; on the free plan Dutch shops connect their own free Peppyrus account. Invoices to consumers never go over Peppol; consumers get their invoice by e-mail.

Who sends the Peppol invoices?

For Belgian shops, PeppolKit sends through its recognised Peppol partner SUPER PDP. When you connect, you confirm your company’s identity once: company number, a consent tick and a photo of your passport or ID card. It takes about 5 minutes. You pay nothing extra per invoice.

What if my customer is not on Peppol?

PeppolKit looks the customer up in the Peppol network. If there is no Peppol address, the invoice is e-mailed as a PDF with the UBL file attached, and the order shows “Customer not on Peppol (e-mailed)”.

Can PeppolKit receive invoices from my suppliers?

Yes. Belgian shops receive Peppol invoices in every plan. Shops in the Netherlands, Germany and Luxembourg can switch receiving on from the Starter plan, for €0.20 per received document. Received invoices show up in the PeppolKit dashboard.

How does the VAT number field work?

The plugin adds an optional VAT number field to the checkout. PeppolKit checks the number live with the EU VIES service. If your customer is in another EU country than your shop and the number is valid, the order is reverse-charged at 0% VAT and the invoice says so. A customer from your own country pays normal VAT. Without a number a business is invoiced as a consumer.

What happens when I reach my monthly invoice limit?

On the free plan (20 invoices a month) new orders are marked as waiting. PeppolKit shows a notice with the number of waiting orders and a button to create their invoices once you have chosen a paid plan; otherwise they are created next month. Paid plans never stop: invoices keep being made past the number in your plan, and the overview suggests a bigger plan. Orders also wait when your company details are missing.

I already had orders before installing PeppolKit.

Go to PeppolKit > Overview and click “Create invoices for paid orders of the last 60 days” (up to 250 orders at a time). These orders are handled like new ones: if e-mailing is on, customers receive their invoice by e-mail, so switch e-mailing off first if you do not want that.

Does it work for shops outside the Netherlands and Belgium?

The seller must be established in the Netherlands, Belgium, France, Germany or Luxembourg. Customers can be anywhere: PeppolKit applies reverse charge for EU businesses, OSS or the €10,000 threshold for EU consumers, and export rules outside the EU.

Does it work with the block checkout and HPOS?

Yes. The VAT number field is added to both the classic and the block checkout, and the plugin works with High-Performance Order Storage.

I already have a VAT number plugin.

That works. PeppolKit reads the customer’s VAT number from EU VAT Assistant (Aelia), EU/UK VAT Validation Manager (WPFactory), the official WooCommerce EU VAT Number extension, Germanized Pro and the Premium version of EU/UK VAT Compliance (Simba). When such a plugin asks for the number, PeppolKit hides its own field so customers do not see two, and leaves removing VAT at checkout to that plugin. PeppolKit still checks the number with VIES for the invoice and Peppol, and notes in the order which plugin the number came from. Want PeppolKit’s field anyway? Tick “Show PeppolKit’s VAT number field anyway” under PeppolKit > Settings > Other WooCommerce plugins.

I use custom order statuses.

Go to PeppolKit > Settings > Other WooCommerce plugins. It lists every order status in your shop, including those from custom order status plugins. Tick the ones that mean “paid” (by default processing and completed). The invoice is made the first time an order reaches one of them, never twice.

I already use a PDF invoice plugin.

Then your customer would get two different invoices for one order. PeppolKit is the one that issues the invoice (with its own gapless number series, the PDF and the Peppol e-invoice), so turn off the other plugin’s invoices. When PDF Invoices & Packing Slips (WP Overnight, also Pro), YITH WooCommerce PDF Invoice, Germanized Pro or WooCommerce PDF Invoices is active, PeppolKit shows a notice with the steps for that plugin. Packing slips can stay on. PeppolKit does not reuse the other plugin’s invoice numbers.

Where do I give my accountant the invoices?

Click “Monthly export” on the overview screen to open the export in the PeppolKit dashboard.

What data does the plugin send to PeppolKit?

The plugin sends the data of paid and refunded orders to app.peppolkit.com: the customer’s name, address, e-mail and VAT number, the order lines and the amounts. PeppolKit uses it to create, check, store and deliver the invoice. You remain the controller of that customer data; PeppolKit is the processor.

What happens when I disconnect or delete the plugin?

Disconnecting removes the API key from your shop. Deleting the plugin also removes its settings and scheduled tasks. Your invoices stay available in your PeppolKit account for 30 days; connect again within that time and everything is kept.

Is the plugin available in Dutch and French?

Invoices can be made in Dutch, French, English or German. Dutch, French and German translations of the admin screens are submitted to translate.wordpress.org.
sections.changelog:
0.3.2

  • Shops in Luxembourg: Luxembourg is in the country list, with the RCS number (B123456) or the 11-digit matricule as registration number, the VAT number hint LU12345678 and the small-business switch for the Luxembourg franchise (art. 57bis LTVA). PeppolKit writes their invoices in French by default.
  • Peppol for shops in the Netherlands, Germany and Luxembourg: from the Starter plan, PeppolKit sends their invoices to business customers over Peppol. The settings and the overview say so, with a button to activate it in the dashboard; German shops now see the Peppol switch, step and column too. Dutch shops on the free plan keep sending through their own free Peppyrus account. Business customers in Germany still get the ZUGFeRD PDF by e-mail.
  • The FAQ now says that PeppolKit also receives suppliers’ Peppol invoices.

0.3.1

  • The PDF’s file name follows the invoice language for customers in Belgium, Luxembourg and Switzerland too: with the automatic invoice language, PeppolKit writes their invoice in the language they shopped in (Dutch, French or German, from WPML or Polylang), and the file name now says the same.

0.3.0

  • The invoice as a PDF attachment to WooCommerce’s own customer e-mails, when you choose that in the PeppolKit dashboard: the order confirmation (processing or completed) and the invoice e-mail carry the invoice once, the refund e-mail the credit note. If the order has no invoice yet, the plugin creates it right away (a few seconds at most) instead of waiting for the background queue. Any problem never stops the e-mail: it then goes without the attachment, with the download link, and the order gets a note.
  • The settings page shows who e-mails the invoice to your customers, with a button to change it in the dashboard.
  • VAT number plugins: PeppolKit takes the customer’s VAT number from EU VAT Assistant (Aelia), EU/UK VAT Validation Manager (WPFactory), WooCommerce EU VAT Number, Germanized Pro and EU/UK VAT Compliance Premium (Simba). Where such a plugin has its own field, PeppolKit hides its field (a setting shows it anyway) and leaves the VAT exemption at checkout to that plugin. The order notes where the number came from.
  • Custom order statuses: choose which order statuses mean paid, custom ones included; each order still gets one invoice. A custom status e-mail of Custom Order Status Manager carries the invoice PDF like the processing e-mail.
  • Other PDF invoice plugins (PDF Invoices & Packing Slips, YITH PDF Invoice, Germanized Pro, WooCommerce PDF Invoices): a notice explains how to avoid sending your customer two different invoices.
  • The PDF’s file name follows the invoice language. The shop language from WPML or Polylang is sent along with the order.

0.2.1

  • Shops in Germany and France: the country list in the settings now has the Netherlands, Belgium, France and Germany.
  • German shops: a field for the Steuernummer (instead of or next to the USt-IdNr.), an optional commercial register number, and invoices in German. The settings and the overview explain that business customers in Germany get a ZUGFeRD e-invoice by e-mail; Peppol is not shown for German shops.
  • Small businesses that charge no VAT (Belgian exemption scheme, Dutch KOR, German Kleinunternehmer under § 19 UStG): a switch in the settings.

0.2.0

  • New pricing: Free up to 20 invoices a month, Starter €9 (100), Growth €19 (500), Pro €49 (unlimited). Paid plans keep invoicing past their number, with a suggestion to upgrade.
  • Belgian shops: Peppol is included for every invoice to a business customer, in every plan, with no cost per send. Connect it once in the PeppolKit dashboard (one-off identity check of about 5 minutes); the settings show when it is connected.
  • Dutch shops: Peppol through your own free Peppyrus account.
  • Overview and settings no longer show Peppol quotas or extra sends that no longer apply; the old “Activate Peppol” button is gone.

0.1.0

  • First version: invoices and credit notes for paid and refunded orders, VIES-checked reverse charge, Peppol sending.
  • PeppolKit menu with an overview (setup checklist, usage bars, latest invoices) and settings.
  • Order box: e-mail status, resend e-mail, send via Peppol / retry.
  • Invoice link on the thank-you page and in the processing / completed e-mails.
  • Waiting orders on plan limit or missing details, with automatic retry after saving settings; backfill for the last 60 days.
  • Retry for credit notes on temporary errors.
  • Disconnect button and clean uninstall.
  • Setting for the EU distance-sales threshold.
